about: The disk map's click hints, by the names Pith keeps them under in its settings (MapHints.all in native/Sources/PithCore/MapHints.swift) and the page learns them by (HINT_STEPS in src/lib/map-hints.ts). Pith saves only the names it knows, so a name the page adds alone would never stay learned. MapHintsTests.swift and hints.test.ts read this file.
